title_fr: Coco ne dort pas ce soir !
one_liner_en: A cozy bedtime story about Coco the axolotl who can't fall asleep — until a magical dolphin friend helps him drift off
one_liner_fr: Une histoire douce du soir : Coco l'axolotl n'arrive pas à dormir — jusqu'à ce qu'un dauphin magique l'aide à s'endormir
key_moments: Coco sees the moon through his window and gets too excited to sleep
He counts stars but keeps losing count
A magical dolphin appears at his bedroom window
The dolphin takes Coco on a calm starlit ocean ride
Coco's eyelids grow heavy as the waves rock him
He falls asleep peacefully, dreaming of the sea
